title: Label: Amarone della Valpolicella
scenario: **Cantine Dal Ponte** · **AMARONE DELLA VALPOLICELLA** · Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita · **Classico** · **2017** · 16% vol · 750 ml

questions.stem: In which Italian region is this wine made?
Which grape makes up 75% of this wine?
What makes Amarone different from most red wines?
choices: it re-ferments in a sealed tank
its grapes are dried before pressing
it is fortified by adding grape spirit
its grapes are hit by noble rot first
questions.explanation: Amarone is made from dried grapes, which explains its high alcohol (16% here).

choices: it was made from one vineyard
it has more alcohol than the minimum
it aged longer in barrel than usual
it comes from the historic zone
questions.explanation: Classico marks the historic production area of an old designation. Longer ageing = Riserva; more alcohol = Superiore.

questions.stem: Amarone and Prosecco come from the same Italian region.
questions.explanation: Both Veneto (Prosecco is Conegliano Valdobbiadene, from Glera).
